name: Uranian-Polje
description: Whatever this world was, it finished. Gray plains run to a dead horizon, interrupted by an ancient meteor crater and the glassed scars of some ancient catastrophe.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
For traders, silicon, salvageable alloys and uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
